tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Corrigendum / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the KPP portal only.

Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid. Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected. The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
As per Government Order NO: FD 884 EXP 12 /2019 Banglore Dated 07-05-2020 action will be taken if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading /forged or fake.

Bidders have to quote and execute the work as per the detailed specification given in Sanctioned estimate and the instructions of the Engineer incharge. The copy of the estimate can be obtained from the Asst. Executive Engineers office, City Corporation Davanagere during Office hours.
All other terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Similar Type of Work done Certificate by the competent authority for arranging capacity building workshop to any Govt organization/ULBs across state and national level in any one of the last five financial years
Bidder Must Submit CA Annual Turnover certificate with UDIN for value not less than 60.00 Lakhs achieved in any two years between 2021-22 to 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder Must Submit Unconditional Line of credit for Rs 20.00 Lakhs/- issued from any scheduled bank.
Bidder should be an empaneled SKP under SBM U 2.0. Bidder must submit SKP Letter issued from MoHUA for the same

The bidder should not have been debarred/blacklisted by any State Government, Central Government, Central & State Govt. undertakings for the reasons of not fulfilling or breach of terms as on the date of tender submission
